rankings.summaryHtml: Remember how LeBron's 2012 was about as storybook as a calendar year could be? 2013 ain't shaping up too badly, either, with the Heat so hot -- on a 35-2 surge -- that they won't worry a bit when they hear how the team with the best record has won it all only once in the past nine seasons.
